name: Herdr Mirror
description: Mirror a remote herdr server's workspaces and agents into the local sidebar

actions.title: Mirror: sync once
actions.description: One-shot mirror pass without starting the daemon

actions.title: Mirror: pause
actions.description: Pause syncing — mirror workspaces stay put; resume with start

actions.title: Mirror: new tab
actions.description: New tab on the remote when invoked inside a mirror; a plain local tab anywhere else

actions.title: Mirror: new workspace
actions.description: New workspace on the remote host (the invoking mirror's host, else hosts.toml default_host)

actions.title: Mirror: split down
actions.description: Split the mirrored remote pane down; splits locally when invoked outside a mirror

actions.title: Mirror: split right
actions.description: Split the mirrored remote pane right; splits locally when invoked outside a mirror

actions.title: Mirror: restore closed mirrors
actions.description: Bring back mirror workspaces/panes you closed locally

actions.title: Mirror: start / resume
actions.description: Start (or resume) the mirror daemon for all configured hosts

actions.title: Mirror: status
actions.description: Log daemon, host, and mirror-object status

actions.title: Mirror: teardown
actions.description: Stop the daemon and close all mirror workspaces
